CustomProperties.Name: CardHeight
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Minimum height of a standard entry card with no sub-detail. Cards grow past this to fit their content.

CustomProperties.Name: FilterOptions
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Table of {Value:Text} rows for the filter dropdown. Values must match Category values in Items and IconMap.

CustomProperties.Name: HideHeader
CustomProperties.Tooltip: When true hides the toolbar with filter entry count and action buttons.

CustomProperties.Name: IconMap
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Maps Category values to icon types, dot colors and card icon colors. Category match is case-insensitive. Include a row with Category="default" as fallback. IconType values are comment, email, document, person, checkbadge, check, workflow, folder. IconColor is a hex string e.g. "#7C3AED" used for the top-right card icon.

CustomProperties.Name: IsLoading
CustomProperties.Tooltip: When true shows skeleton placeholder cards instead of data.

CustomProperties.Name: Items
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Audit trail entries. Schema - EventTitle, EventDescription, Author, DisplayDateTime, Category (must match FilterOptions values and IconMap), HasSubDetail, SubTo, SubCC, SubPriority (High or Normal), SubMessage. Cards size themselves to their content, so cap long SubMessage values at the source if you need a bounded row height. No IconType needed - derived automatically from Category via IconMap.

CustomProperties.Name: OnExport
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the export button is tapped.

CustomProperties.Name: OnItemSelect
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when an audit trail card is tapped.

CustomProperties.Name: OnPrint
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the print button is tapped.

CustomProperties.Name: SelectedItem
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The last tapped audit trail record.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowScrollbar
CustomProperties.Tooltip: When true shows the scrollbar on the timeline gallery.

CustomProperties.Name: SubDetailCardHeight
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Minimum height of an entry card that includes the sub-detail panel. Also sets the initial height of the sub-detail block before it measures its content. Cards grow past this to fit their content.

CustomProperties.Name: ThemeConfig
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Light and Dark theme token sets. Override to customise colors.
